items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I saw this cat, Peg ? , man, he was a Rembrandt picture. He was tall and elegant. I said, 'Man, I'd like to look like that.'

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. / It was heavy. The guy that staged the show was Leonard Harper Hopper. He had all them girls and different acts, of course, the first time we had a regular Broadway production up there and it was all right, you know, it wasn't nothing difficult about it. but we had the exact timing. We had the Nicholas Brothers the Berry Brothers, Peg Leg Bates Ethel Waters, they were the head -- a dance team and oh, 16 prettiest girls you ever saw, in the chorus, and they this show we rehearsed about -- we rehearsed…

Yeah, we played the show, but I mean the new show, had about three weeks after we come in there, so we just played entertainment while they were rehearsing, but opening night, everybody in New York was there.
